fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (SKHY +9.71%) achieved revenue of approximately $7.26 billion as of December 31, 2025 (46.8% year-over-year growth), net income of approximately $3.21 billion, and net profit margin of 44.2%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Nvidia (NVDA +2.87%) recorded revenue of approximately $215.9 billion as of January 25, 2026 (65.5% year-over-year growth), net income of approximately $120.1 billion, and net profit margin of 55.6%, though risks exist due to customer concentration (top customers at 22% and 14% of revenue).
